WITH constructor_record_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.constructorId,
    COUNT(*) as count_records
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  GROUP BY cs.constructorId
),
average_records AS (
  SELECT AVG(count_records) as avg_count
  FROM constructor_record_counts
)
SELECT 
  c.constructorId,
  c.nationality,
  crc.count_records,
  crc.count_records - ar.avg_count as difference_from_average
FROM constructor_record_counts crc
CROSS JOIN average_records ar
JOIN constructors c ON crc.constructorId = c.constructorId
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
